theorem binomial_digit_iff_choose (C N K : ℕ) :
    (∃ β τ π q r : ℕ, β = 2 ^ (N + 1) ∧ τ = (β + 1) ^ N ∧ π = β ^ K ∧ C < β ∧ r < π ∧
      τ = π * (β * q + C) + r) ↔ C = Nat.choose N K := by
